positive_snippets: The hotel is ideally located just a few kilometers from Indira Gandhi International Airport. The staff is friendly and courteous, and I highly recommend this hotel. If you enjoy Punjabi cuisine, this is a great place to try it. They also have a spacious garden where you can sit and relax.
negative_snippets: The rooms are average. The rates are so high for anything you take from their refrigerator. They even don’t provide you complementary water bottles, that most of the hotels provide you without any charges. The price for everything is double. I would suggest, if you are living in this hotel don’t touch their refrigerator. They just want to rip you off.

It's very strange, this might be the only hotel who does not have drinking water in the room. You need to buy at an exorbitant high' price from them. The food items are very high priced...rooms are very small but only positive is the location.
Good service and food is average. Price is bit high. Good for a stay. Need some cleanings and some new room items though.
